name: Shuri Seihajuu Nagasaki
original_name: シュリ・セイハジュウ・ナガサキ
source:
Shuri Seihajuu Nagasaki, usually merely addressed as Shuri, is the cheerful and friendly receptionist of the Coliseum where the Toushin Toshi Tournament is hosted.
